one: The core reinforcement learning course: MDPs, value iteration, policy gradients, exploration, with deep RL in the assignments.
pos: CS 234 covers the main line of RL from tabular methods to deep RL, with an emphasis on how autonomous systems make decisions through trial and error. It fits sequential decision-making in robotics, games, recommendation, and healthcare, and is a prerequisite for CS 224R/CS 332.
topics: **MDP basics**: returns, Bellman equations, policy evaluation
**Model-free methods**: Monte Carlo, TD, Q-learning, SARSA
**Deep RL and offline RL**: stability issues in practice
**Project**: usually train an agent on a control or game task
prereq: Fluent Python; CS 229 or equivalent ML background; linear algebra and probability.
assess: Typically 3–4 assignments plus a midterm and a project; at least one deep RL assignment. Check the current syllabus for details.
who: Robotics, RL research, game AI, and recommender systems; anyone working on embodied AI.
tips: Master MDPs and dynamic programming before deep RL. For the exploration part, read Chapters 2–3 of Sutton & Barto.
note: Not offered in the 2026–27 ExploreCourses listing; this page is based on the most recent offering.
